name: scene-unload
title: Scene / Unload
description: Unload scene from the Opened scenes in Unity Editor. Use 'scene-list-opened' tool to get the list of all opened scenes.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the opened scene to unload (not the path). Get from scene-list-opened.

notes: scene-unload 属于场景受保护命令；若当前打开场景栈可能存在生成场景 dirty，调用时必须显式传 bridgeSceneDirtyPolicy
若只是切换验证流程并丢弃已知生成场景残留，优先传 bridgeSceneDirtyPolicy=discard-generated
